question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What was your favorite part of the ski trip?

labels: Maybe if I wanted to end up in prison.

nodes.text: At $ZOE's door...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good night, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good night, Howard.
As $ZOE closes the door, Howard hears a noise behind him and sees Andy trying to open the next door down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Andy. I haven't seen you around all weekend.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, I've been kind of busy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Busy? With what? Skiing?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Er, yeah. `Skiing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, yeah. [color=#e23b3b][i]Skiing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Need some help getting into your room?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? Me? I'm, uh, good. Just fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think a key would help...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're right, Howard. I should go find one. Thanks for the advice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem.
Andy walks off, and Howard shrugs and goes the other way down the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Skinny-dipping?! I can't believe you'd say that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gutsy, Howard. But how willing are you to drop your shorts right now?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa there, keep your shorts on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen, Slushie, that's fun to do late at night with your girl, but not in a hot springs right now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was an idea...
Everyone sits in silence in the hot springs.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk-ward...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm turning in.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yawn. Yeah, I'm tired. Let's go, girls.
Taylor and the other cheerleaders climb out of the hot springs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If there are no more bikinis in this pool... I'm out. Way to kill a party, Slushie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going inside. Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk you in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now that sounds like good unwholesome fun, Slushie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha. Think of all the dares we could make in a lodge like this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Streak through the lobby... Lick a flagpole... Snowboard off the roof of the lodge!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good idea, Howard. This sounds like fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad there's a 'Truth' option.
A couple minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spike, I can't believe you chose 'dare'! Now you have to make out with a snowman...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa... Whoa... Can we at least make it a `snow woman?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... Whoa... Can we at least make it a [color=#e23b3b][i]snow woman?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Done! Howard, build a snow-woman!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have no idea what that entails...
And later still...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Truth for all the boys! What is the craziest place you've made out?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a closet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: In a classroom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: On a motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Under the aurora borealis on top of a horse atop a mountain!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...How does that even work?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Romantically.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh wow...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ooh...
And eventually...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yawn... This was really fun! But I'm sleepy. I'm going to head in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk you back.
Later, the students gather at the hot springs...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahhh... Hot springs in winter. Best. Thing. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As fun as this is... We need to spice things up a bit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have an idea for something to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Like what, play tiddlywinks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, a `good` idea. Something like...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, a [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] idea. Something like...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have a candidate here!
Howard raises $ZOE's hand for her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You talk in front of people all the time as a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But usually, I'm standing up there with all the other cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm scared being on stage and singing `by myself!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm scared being on stage and singing [color=#3b78e2][i]by myself![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Where's our volunteer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE, hurry up. Get up there and sing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sing! Sing!
$ZOE takes the stage to applause but freezes as the music starts to play!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Way to go, Slushie. You know $ZOE's shy. You shouldn't go pushing her onstage!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go save her, Howard!
Before Howard can move, the Hawk jumps in and starts singing with $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: { Ninety-eight green balloons... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Flying in the open sky... {
$ZOE and Hawk Gunner finish the song together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Hawk.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk needs no thanks. The Hawk will do anything for you.
$ZOE walks back to where Howard and Sam sit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You okay? I'm sorry I tried to get you to do a solo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm fine. I didn't mean to freak out. I just panicked.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You did say you wanted to try new things, so I thought karaoke might be one of them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do. But when I said that, I didn't mean that you should volunteer me for a solo!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And that wraps up the set for tonight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyone up for a trip to the hot springs? Hawk, you coming?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk will go anywhere for the laaa-dies.
Howard raises his and $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll sing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'We'?! Howard, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're singing. Come on!
Howard takes $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I'm not sure I want to do this. I've never sung in front of other people.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But how is this any different than performing in front of people as a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Usually I'm standing up there with the `other cheerleaders.` And cheerleading is not singing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Usually I'm standing up there with the [color=#3b78e2][i]other cheerleaders.[/i][/color] And cheerleading is not singing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This time, you're standing up with me. I'll back you up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you really get into trouble, I'll just start singing really loudly. And badly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. Okay. What are we singing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Summer Days' from the musical 'Slick'...
$ZOE and Howard take the stage, and the music starts...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { I met a gal, nuts over me...  {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { I met a guy, dear as can be... {

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { Summer haze, love is a maze... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { But leads to those summer daaaaaaayyyyyys... {
As the song ends, the student audience bursts into applause.
$ZOE and Howard step down from the stage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, who knew you were such a Don Revolta?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was really fun. Thanks for dragging me up there, Howard. I don't think I would've been able to do it by myself!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And that wraps up the set for tonight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyone up for a trip to the hot springs? Hawk, you coming?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk will go anywhere for the laaa-dies.
Later, Howard and $ZOE gather in the lodge hall for karaoke with the rest of the class.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's with the Christmas stuff?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think it's nice that they keep all the decorations up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If by that you mean, nice they kept all the `presents out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If by that you mean, nice they kept all the [color=#e23b3b][i]presents out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt grabs a present and shakes it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, they're all empty.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is Hawk Gunner running karaoke?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently, the Hawk does `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Apparently, the Hawk does [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk knows some eager ladies are out there looking for a chance to sing...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: How about that beautiful blonde chick there?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd love to, Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was talking to `me,` Taylor.
nodes.text_bbcode: He was talking to [color=#3b78e2][i]me,[/i][/color] Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Maybe you two can sing together?
Taylor and Jessica go up and sing their duet.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: { I see you cruisin' round the block with the guy I dig... {

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: { And I'm, like, dismiss youuuuu... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, singing looks like so much fun! I wish I had the courage to do that.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We're rounding out our song list... Any last volunteers want to test their mettle and belt it out up here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I could nominate her for a solo like Hawk did... Or offer to do a duet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should...
$ZOE, Colt, and Sam follow Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So where's the run, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're looking at it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This looks...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Incredibly lame!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boring, even for you, Slushie. Come on, Sam, let's go.
Colt and Sam ski down the hill, leaving Howard and $ZOE behind.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. I'm sure it'll be fun. I know I can handle this hill.
$ZOE tries to ski forward, but not before a small child stumbles past her on skis.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, careful there! That was close.
$ZOE tries to ski forward again, but nearly trips over another child!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, there are kids everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just take it slow.
Slowly and carefully, $ZOE and Howard navigate around the children as they make their way down the small slope.
At the bottom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, that run was awful! Can we go back to the lodge now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.
$ZOE, Colt, and Sam follow Howard to a formidable looking hill.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm shocked, Howard. This actually looks like a challenge.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Howard, this seems... Kind of difficult.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You said you wanted to take on more this year. Don't underestimate yourself now.
Howard, $ZOE, Sam, and Colt ski down the slope.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was unbelievably fun! I didn't know I could go that fast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for convincing me to go on this one, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you rookies are up for a real challenge... We'll go down the double black diamond run tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt's joking. Well, about the bank robbing anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we can be more adventurous together then, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The thing I like best about Colt is that he always takes me to do exciting things...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE, hear that? If you want 'more adventurous', you can hang out with me any time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe Howard should take some lessons from Colt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. Totally.
After a couple hours on the train...
The school bus lets all the students out in the middle of a winter wonderland!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Real snow! Howard, this is amazing! It's so pretty!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All right, kids, you have a few hours out here on the slopes before we check into the hotel!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: For those of you who don't know how to ski, I'd like to introduce... `Hawk Gunner.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For those of you who don't know how to ski, I'd like to introduce... [color=#3b78e2][i]Hawk Gunner.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk-ah!
A fit young man jumps off a ski ramp, spins all the way around while grabbing his skis!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nice 540 tail grab!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, it's the move you can only make by punching six buttons in the right order!
Hawk lands in the circle of gawking students.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hey, laaaa-dies. The Hawk has landed and likes what he sees.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hello there, Hawk...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Looks like our snow cold weekend, just got hotter, girls.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee-hee. He looks like a model!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who is this guy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's `really cute.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#3b78e2][i]really cute.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That jump was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's totally handsome... I mean, in that athletic jock kind of way.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Who wants to take on the slopes with the Hawk?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure. Sounds like fun.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, me too!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: `The Hawk` sees a lovely snow bunny to be preyed on...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The Hawk[/i][/color] sees a lovely snow bunny to be preyed on...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk will be happy to be your ski instructor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll show him some snow bunnies.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What does that even mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going with you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, you coming or not?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I could ski... Or I could play `Solemn Slalom 4,` the ultimate ski experience!
nodes.text_bbcode: I could ski... Or I could play [color=#e23b3b][i]Solemn Slalom 4,[/i][/color] the ultimate ski experience!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, this is the only way to ski... With a controller!
The nerds run inside the ski lodge to set up WeeBoxes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess his girlfriend's not in danger of getting picked up by Hawk 'I'm-a-Tool' Gunner.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Laaaa-dies... Right this way...
Hawk leads a trail of girls and Hector and Howard to the ski lift.
One ski lift ride later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Bunny slopes, here I come!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, is that why you're wearing a bunny costume?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course! To attract all the bunnies, silly.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And where are you two lovely ladies going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know. I've only skied once or twice before... I don't know if I can handle a big hill...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk would be happy to go to the advanced hills with you.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Adventure is the Hawk's middle name...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which one do you want to go on, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE does want to be more adventurous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think you can handle...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice comeback, Slushie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like someone is finally standing up for himself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, no...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Slushie. That's the best comeback you have?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is what happens when you never do anything exciting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you have?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Uhm...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that, Slushie? I couldn't hear you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is what happens when you never do anything exciting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you have?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Time's up! Pass your papers forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Psst, Howard, move your head a little.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just do it!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All right, class, I just graded your papers, and it looks like...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Everyone is going on the ski trip!
And that's how it all started...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Everyone is going on the ski trip...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: ...Except Howard and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Vanilla... I `trusted` you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Vanilla... I [color=#e23b3b][i]trusted[/i][/color] you...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You two are stuck at home for the entire weekend finishing this make-up exam I have for you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Howard, Colt, I'm disappointed. Try to take your academic work more seriously. School isn't exclusively for socializing and dating!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I hope next time you both make better choices.
That weekend...
Howard and the rest of the students enjoy the train ride on the way to the ski slopes!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, Angie, look at this dining car! This train is great!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And not only do we get this train free of charge, but the ski lodge is practically rented out only to us!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Practically?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aside from some execs from Prince Automotives, the entire lodge is ours for the taking. Isn't that awesome?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, this entire weekend `sounds` great, but don't you think it's a little weird that we're getting such a great deal out of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott, this entire weekend [color=#3b78e2][i]sounds[/i][/color] great, but don't you think it's a little weird that we're getting such a great deal out of it?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sometimes it's better to go along with these types of things and not ask questions.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: As President, shouldn't you ask more?
And in another corner of the train...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So then Dinah tells me about what she did all day, and I tell her about what I did all day, and then we play Warscrewdriver Online together to bond.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can tell you for sure that that's not what Amanda and I do to `bond.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can tell you for sure that that's not what Amanda and I do to [color=#e23b3b][i]bond.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do I even want to know?
And elsewhere on the train...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And it's all thanks to Howard here that I'm on this trip.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe you cheated off Howard's test.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It all makes sense now...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, look on the bright side. Howard could've done badly, and then we'd both be at home, missing this exciting ski trip.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, Sam, what did you and Colt do for New Year's?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, you know, he snuck me into the park so we could watch the fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a shame you didn't come... Hector's party was a lot of fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There were really great costumes and food. And we all shared our resolutions!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Resolutions? Who needs a resolution when you're me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What was your resolution, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This year, I resolve to be more outgoing and adventurous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I wanted to do something I've never done before.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like what, shave?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm just saying, I bet Slushie over here has never done your basic car-lifting or bank robbing.

options.label: Maybe if I wanted to end up in prison.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam talked about how interesting the bear fight was...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lyle the Lizard? Our mascot's not in classic literature!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That `can't` be right!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]can't[/i][/color] be right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't remember Sam or $ZOE talking about that at all!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't remember Sam or $ZOE talking about that at all!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Time's up. Next question!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: What animal did Bryce hunt to survive?

nodes.prompt: What animal did Bryce hunt to survive?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What animal did Bryce hunt to survive?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where did Sam say it was good to have an ax?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a zombie brain, of course, but... where else?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where did Sam say it was good to have an ax?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a zombie brain, of course, but... where else?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam said it was good to have an ax in the `Pacific Northwest!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam said it was good to have an ax in the [color=#e23b3b][i]Pacific Northwest![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Canada's not part of the United States!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Okay. Next question.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: In what region of the United States was Bryce lost in?

nodes.prompt: In what region of the United States was Bryce lost?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: In what region of the United States was Bryce lost?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The name of the book is 'Hax', so it must be 'ax'! Yeah, that's right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope that was right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope that was right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope that was right...
Everything felt heavy. My face was frozen, and it was deathly cold.
I couldn't figure out where I was for a moment... Then I heard a voice...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Howard? `Howard?` You still alive?
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard? [color=#e23b3b][i]Howard?[/i][/color] You still alive?

nodes.text: Not the voice I wanted to hear, but it made me remember... We were trapped...
When this week started out, I didn't expect to be stuck with Colt...
No, I had much bigger, better plans...
But let's start at the beginning...
A week earlier...
Howard, $ZOE, Sam, and Colt walk to class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, Howard, you `didn't` do the reading last night?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, Howard, you [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] do the reading last night?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It slipped my mind. Football practice ran late, Brendan and Hector both called in a panic about Brendan's relationship, and then $ZOE wanted to talk...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just kind of forgot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But don't you remember that you can only go on the school ski trip this weekend if you pass Ms. Prez's quiz on the book?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The local author who's sponsoring the ski trip wanted us all to read his work, and Ms. Prez said the only way to make sure we read something was to test us on it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm surprised you want to go on the ski trip so much. Weren't you the one that said you didn't like going on the ski slopes when you were a kid?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was before I read the assignment. It's called 'Hax', and it's a story about a computer programmer, Bryce, who survives in the wild after a plane crash.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That book was `so boring.` If it hadn't been for the part where Bryce fights the bear, I don't think I would've read as much as I did.
nodes.text_bbcode: That book was [color=#3b78e2][i]so boring.[/i][/color] If it hadn't been for the part where Bryce fights the bear, I don't think I would've read as much as I did.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A bear? What are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The lame book about the guy with the ax.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, okay. Never mind. I thought we were talking about something important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought 'Hax' was a fascinating commentary on how at-odds modern man is with nature.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or how cool it is to have an ax when you're stuck in the Sierra Mountains?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe that too. I really liked the story. It made me think about all the adventures I haven't gone on yet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, I've been hungry and stuck in the woods before when I tried to break out of Boot Camp. It's no adventure.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Give me a flat-screen TV and take-out food any day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The point is, I wanted you to pass the quiz and come on this ski trip, so we can have our own adventure together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, $ZOE. It'll be fine. You've practically given me the summary already.
The bell rings, and the students file into English class.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: As most of you know, thanks to the reclusive and mysterious author, Daniell Y. Cannon, our class ski trip to the Sierras is this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, Ms. Prez. I've been polishing my skis all week.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And I hope you all remember that, to go on this trip, everyone has to do well on the quiz about 'Hax'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, if we don't pass, we can't go?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: If you don't pass, you get to stay at home reading the book you were supposed to have read by `today.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you don't pass, you get to stay at home reading the book you were supposed to have read by [color=#3b78e2][i]today.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: The entire reason for this ski trip is because Mr. Cannon himself is sponsoring us.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, everyone get a blank piece of paper, and I'll read your first question.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can do this. I just have to remember what Sam and $ZOE were talking about!

nodes.prompt: What tool did Bryce carry around with him?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What tool did Bryce carry around with him?

nodes.text: Howard skies down like a pro, maneuvering between moguls and other obstacles.
Colt slides to a stop at the bottom, and Howard pulls up behind him, spraying snow in his face.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wow, Slushie, I'm more impressed than I thought I would be.
Howard and Colt high-five!
The high-five results in a loud clapping sound that echoes through the woods.
Howard digs through the snow, scooping handfuls out of the way and pushing forward.
A couple minutes later, Howard's hand breaks the surface!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Colt over here!
Colt and Howard dig themselves out, one scoopful of snow at a time until at last...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're free!
Howard and Colt hoist themselves out of the newly-dug hole onto the mountain side.
Howard cautiously makes his way down to the ledge where Colt hangs precariously.
Howard runs up the hill.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: SLUSHIE!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You are so dead when I get back up there!
Colt grabs a nearby tree branch, hoists himself up, and stomps angrily up to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I knew you were Vanilla, but I didn't think you'd actually wuss out on me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only thing that's keeping me from leaving you here neck-deep in snow is that it'll stop Sammy from making out with me if $ZOE is unhappy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's get back.
Howard freezes in place, watching helplessly as Colt slides down

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: SLUSHIE!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A little help here?!
Howard rushes over to the ledge where Colt is helping himself up.
Colt grabs a nearby tree branch and hoists himself up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're useless to me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only thing that's keeping me from leaving you here neck-deep in snow is that it'll stop Sammy from making out with me if $ZOE is unhappy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's get back.
Howard digs through the snow, scooping handfuls out of the way and moving forward.
A few minutes later...
Howard's hand hits something! He strikes up again.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Owwww! That's my nose! What's the big idea?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We dug in a circle!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well done, genius. Have any other bright ideas? Want to make fire out of snow?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At least we know digging this way isn't the right way. Let's tunnel up.
An hour later, at long last...
Howard and Colt dig themselves out of the snow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: S-o c-c-c-cold...
Painfully, Howard and Colt hoist themselves out of the newly-dug hole onto the mountain side.
Colt tries to stand, but suddenly slips and slides down the hill!
Howard tries to carve through the snow, but the steep angle of the mountain throws him off!
Howard tumbles forward, losing his skis and rolling down. At the bottom, Colt slides to a stop, and Howard stops at his feet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wow, Slushie, if that's what you call good skiing, I'd hate to see what a bad day is for you.
Howard tries to stand up, but slips, landing with a loud thwump that echoes through the woods.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So laaaa-dies, ready for more lessons with the Hawk?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We could visit more bunny slopes or jump off ramps on the intermediate slopes... Or I can take one or more lucky, young chick-lings back to my nest...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tee hee.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So hot...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, no one hits on Sammy and gets away with it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Hotshot, if you're so good, ski down the double black diamond run, Suicide Slice!
The students in the courtyard stop to watch this exchange.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But that's... On the back of the mountain!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you going to do it, Hawk?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk hears a challenge... And responds...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Yes. The Hawk will go down this run.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But it could be dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: 'Danger' is Hawk's middle name...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wasn't it 'Adventure'?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It's both.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Slushie, you coming?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know if I can go down a hill called Suicide Slice...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? You're a wuss? Because that's what I just heard come out of your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Count me in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on. Hawk, Slushie, let's show these girls what we got.
A ski lift later...
Howard, Colt, Hawk, and the girls are deposited at the top of Suicide Slice.
$ZOE looks down at a straight drop and gulps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not a run... That's a cliff!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure you boys want to do this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course! Nothing like a little free fall to make your run more exciting. I'm off!
Colt fastens the straps on his snowboard and takes off down the slope!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk will go down last.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's now or never.
Howard pushes off...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Watch out, $ZOE!
Howard chucks a snowball at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Howard! Why would you do that?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, in that case...
Taylor flings a snowball at Howard, hitting him squarely in the jaw!
Howard and Taylor enter a vicious snowball war until...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm out! Truce?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Truce. $ZOE? I defended your honor... $ZOE?
Howard looks over where $ZOE and Hawk are making angels in the snow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard! Sorry. You were just so caught up fighting with Taylor, I got a little bored. So Hawk suggested I make a snow angel, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was trying to defend you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's really sweet. Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...
Howard throws a snowball at $ZOE. It splatters all over her jacket!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! I can't believe you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not as sorry as you're `going` to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not as sorry as you're [color=#3b78e2][i]going[/i][/color] to be!

nodes.text: $ZOE lobs a soft snowball at Howard, but Howard dodges!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hah!
$ZOE and Howard play in the snow until a ceasefire is called.
Hawk Gunner walks up.
The next morning...
Howard, $ZOE, and the rest of the students file into the ski lodge courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Snow! It snowed all of last night!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you know what that means...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Snowball fight!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
In another part of the courtyard...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We've done this before, Sammy. Put the snowball down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I beat you once before, and I can do it again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah right! The last time, I won.
Colt and Sam stand at ease... Before hurling their snowballs at each other!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! You cheat!
And in another corner...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, girls. There are two targets hiding behind the rock on the right and another one behind the left tree.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot everyone. Take no prisoners.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Take no prisoners!
Taylor, Jessica, and Maria jump from behind a tree and start pelting everyone in sight.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa, easy there, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We're the basketball team, not your enemies!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eat snow, dirtbags!
Taylor takes down several people with snowballs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who's next? Ah... Some unsuspecting cheerleaders!
Taylor starts throwing snowballs at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!
Howard picks up a snowball.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I could throw this at Taylor to protect $ZOE...
Howard sees Sam and Colt running through the snow, shrieking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or I could throw it at $ZOE...
Howard uses nearby tree branch and extends it to Colt.
Colt grabs for it, but it breaks!
Howard stares dumbly at the broken tree branch.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A little help here?!
Colt grabs a nearby rock and hoists himself up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Slushie, you're useless to me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only thing that's keeping me from leaving you here neck-deep in snow is that it'll stop Sammy from making out with me if $ZOE is unhappy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's get back.
scopnw

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Slushie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe you're not completely useless after all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, that's what I meant to say.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's get back.
But not quite a perfect ending! Play again to get that perfect score!
Or else see you next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks to Slushie here.
After an hour of walking...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but I'm beat. Aren't we close to `anything` right now?
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate to admit it, but I'm beat. Aren't we close to [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] right now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have to keep moving. If we stay here, we'll freeze to death.
Suddenly, the boys hear a snowmobile round the corner!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! Help!
The snowmobile pulls around, and its headlights catch Howard and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You the fooligans caught out in the avalanche? I'm out here to take you home.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There are two young Bonnies who are waiting to see you.
Back at the lodge...
Sam and $ZOE wait tensely for news of the boys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I shouldn't have let them talk me out of going with them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Be glad you didn't go. Otherwise, you'd be stuck out there in the avalanche!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But now `they're` out there stuck in the avalanche!
nodes.text_bbcode: But now [color=#3b78e2][i]they're[/i][/color] out there stuck in the avalanche!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Will the bunnies be okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Hawk Gunner, what can you tell us about the avalanche?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It was a huge snow pile! The Hawk saw it and skied down with great speed and agility...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: ...Dodging trees left and right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait a minute... That's not what really happened...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk is talking.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk skied down, rescuing defenseless animals along the way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh wow! How nice of you!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk barely escaped with his life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, let's see if you can do that again once I'm through with you.
Colt and Officer Monte walk up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's only been a couple hours. Miss me already?
Sam runs up to Colt and hugs him fiercely.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, Sammy, are you crying?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I'm crying, `stupid!` You disappeared on me again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I'm crying, [color=#3b78e2][i]stupid![/i][/color] You disappeared on me again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, babe, I'm fine...
Howard walks up to the group. $ZOE runs to him and jumps into his arms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... I thought you might have been hurt... Or worse!
Howard leans in close.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry I left you at the top of the hill. But how did you girls get down? Did Hawk Gunner help?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That idiot?
A few hours earlier, at the top of the hill...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you guys hear that sharp, cracking noise?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It's an avalanche!
Sam, $ZOE, and Hawk watch a wave of snow cascade down the hill!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! Howard! Hawk, we have to rescue them. What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk suggests you run...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you have any useful advice? They're trapped out there! Can't you help at all?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk is too pretty to die.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: In cases like this, 'Flee' is the Hawk's middle name!
Hawk Gunner charges down the mountain, leaving $ZOE and Sam to fend for themselves!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Turns out, the Hawk is just all `squawk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Turns out, the Hawk is just all [color=#3b78e2][i]squawk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, I never should've let you go down alone. That's not what I meant by adventurous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know that real adventures were super stressful!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I admit, maybe I went a little overboard trying to be like a cooler 'Hawk Gunner'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I just wanted to be the kind of guy you could do daring stuff with, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant, trying new things like eating different foods and picking up new hobbies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not skiing down a cliff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just happy you're safe.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just know that if you wanted me to, I'd ski down a cliff for you any day, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're sweet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, 'Sweet' is my middle name...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hush.
Howard and $ZOE hold each other for a long time.
Howard survived an avalanche and figured out how to be a better guy for $ZOE.
All because you played a great game!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: An hour later, Howard and Colt find themselves back at the ski lodge...
Howard sees $ZOE, Sam, and the rest of the school waiting in front of the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're back...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You look upset. Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything's okay... For me, that is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I have something to tell you.
Suddenly, Hawk appears from behind the building!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: More like, `we` have to tell you something.
nodes.text_bbcode: More like, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Hawk?
$ZOE crosses to Hawk and takes his hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please stop fighting. Howard, this is what I wanted to tell you about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember when I said I wanted to be more adventurous this year?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought about it, and you just don't seem like the type of guy I can do that with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you chose Hawk?! I'd almost rather you go after Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hawk is the perfect guy to start my new adventurous life with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean for this to happen, but since you and Colt were gone for so long...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, since we were trapped in a snow bank during an avalanche?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, that. Sam and I looked for you two for hours with one of the rescue groups before coming back to the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And since you'd been gone for so long, Hawk and I just got to talking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And he's done so many thing I'd like to try!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He doesn't do everything his parents tell him to, he stays out after ten o'clock, and he's even tried spicy food!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard, but I'm leaving with Hawk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now wait a minute, $ZOE. I don't think you should do that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because... I'm leaving with Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt, but I can't resist Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa, hang on there, Sam. I'm the one who'll be leaving with Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it's going to be `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Laaaaa-dies, there's enough Hawk to go around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe this!
Hawk is running off with everyone's girlfriend?!
Play again and see if you can get a better ending for Howard and $ZOE!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: But we never made it...
After an hour of walking, Colt and I realized something was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, Slushie, but I'm beat. Are we any closer to civilization?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... In fact, I think we're crossing our own trail again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We must have gone in a circle instead of towards the lodge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aren't you supposed to be good with this nature stuff? Didn't I hear you say you escaped from Boot Camp or something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not like I learned that many useful skills while I was running from Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's nothing to do, but make a shelter and hope we get rescued. We can walk more tomorrow, and maybe someone will find us...
But no one came.
In the weeks that followed the ski trip, Colt and I built a small wooden shelter, foraged for food, and struggled to keep warm.
It was a lonely existence, and the winter weather was harsh.
Often, Colt and I dreamed of warmer, more comfortable times...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Remember when we had that hot tub? And it was hot?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember when we had a bed and pillows and blankets?
Or we'd dream of food, so much food...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wish I could just go to a grocery store and buy something instead of have to run after our food.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'd kill for a hamburger, French fries, and a shake.
And of course, we dreamed of our loved ones...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I would give to make out with Sammy again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wonder if $ZOE is okay. I don't even remember the last thing I said to her. I hope I was nice...
Colt and Howard stuck in the Sierra wilderness without any hope of rescue?!
That's a terrible ending! Try again and see if you can make some better choices to keep them from getting lost!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: All of a sudden a sharp crack and rumbling can be heard!
A large snow bank falls and cascades down the mountain like a flood.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have to ask?! Avalanche!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Run!
Howard and Colt run as the snow overtakes and buries them!
And that's how Colt and I got stuck in an avalanche together.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Howard? `Howard?` You alive?
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard? [color=#e23b3b][i]Howard?[/i][/color] You alive?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. You okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I blame you for this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That makes no sense. You're the one that wanted to ski down Suicide Slice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what? If anyone's to blame, it's Hawk Gunner. He didn't even snowboard down with us!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I really hate that guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, hate him later. We need to get out of here, and the only way to do that is by tunneling out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, all right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dig!
An hour later, Howard and Colt find themselves back at the ski lodge...
Howard sees $ZOE, Sam, and the rest of the school waiting in front of the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're back...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You look upset. Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything's okay... For me, that is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I have something to tell you.
Suddenly, Hawk appears from behind the building!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: More like, `we` have to tell you something.
nodes.text_bbcode: More like, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Hawk?
$ZOE crosses to Hawk and takes his hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please stop fighting. Howard, this is what I wanted to tell you about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember when I said I wanted to be more adventurous this year?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought about it, and you just don't seem like the type of guy I can do that with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you chose Hawk?! I'd almost rather you go after Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hawk is the perfect guy to start my new adventurous life with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean for this to happen, but since you and Colt were gone for so long...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, since we were trapped in a snow bank during an avalanche?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, that. Sam and I looked for you two for hours with one of the rescue groups before coming back to the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And since you'd been gone for so long, Hawk and I just got to talking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And he's done so many thing I'd like to try!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He doesn't do everything his parents tell him to, he stays out after ten o'clock, and he's even tried spicy food!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard, but I'm leaving with Hawk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now wait a minute, $ZOE. I don't think you should do that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because... I'm leaving with Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt, but I can't resist Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa, hang on there, Sam. I'm the one who'll be leaving with Hawk!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it's going to be `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Laaaaa-dies, there's enough Hawk to go around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe this!
Hawk is running off with everyone's girlfriend?!
Play again and see if you can get a better ending for Howard and $ZOE!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: But we never made it...
After an hour of walking, Colt and I realized something was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, Slushie, but I'm beat. Are we any closer to civilization?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... In fact, I think we're crossing our own trail again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We must have gone in a circle instead of towards the lodge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aren't you supposed to be good with this nature stuff? Didn't I hear you say you escaped from Boot Camp or something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not like I learned that many useful skills while I was running from Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's nothing to do, but make a shelter and hope we get rescued. We can walk more tomorrow, and maybe someone will find us...
But no one came.
In the weeks that followed the ski trip, Colt and I built a small wooden shelter, foraged for food, and struggled to keep warm.
It was a lonely existence, and the winter weather was harsh.
Often, Colt and I dreamed of warmer, more comfortable times...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Remember when we had that hot tub? And it was hot?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember when we had a bed and pillows and blankets?
Or we'd dream of food, so much food...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wish I could just go to a grocery store and buy something instead of have to run after our food.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'd kill for a hamburger, French fries, and a shake.
And of course, we dreamed of our loved ones...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I would give to make out with Sammy again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wonder if $ZOE is okay. I don't even remember the last thing I said to her. I hope I was nice...
Colt and Howard stuck in the Sierra wilderness without any hope of rescue?!
That's a terrible ending! Try again and see if you can make some better choices to keep them from getting lost!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: And that's how I came to be stuck `here...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's how I came to be stuck [b]here...[/b]

nodes.text: Suddenly the lights go on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Howard? `Howard?` You alive?
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard? [color=#e23b3b][i]Howard?[/i][/color] You alive?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because you won't be for long...
Colt storms into the locker room and crosses to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Colt, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know why I'm here, Slushie. Did you think hiding from me in the locker room was going to save you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I have something to show you. Sammy sent me a text. You want to know what it says?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Text back when you're done keying cars'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Colt, wish u were here...'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: '... But we're having a `great time` without you!'
nodes.text_bbcode: '... But we're having a [color=#e23b3b][i]great time[/i][/color] without you!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So? I got the same message from $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, it's your fault I'm not on the ski trip with Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I copied off your test, and you got all the answers wrong.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, isn't that your fault for not studying?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up. The point is, I figured you were at least golden boy enough to get good grades, so I cheated off you, and you let me down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you know what happens to people who let me down?
Colt brings up his two clenched fists.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gulp!
Colt is about to punch Howard? $ZOE and Sam are having fun without their boys on the ski slopes?
Wow, Howard needs to get better at acing his quizzes... Or at least get better at faking it!
Try again and see if you can get Howard onto that ski trip!!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No thanks to Slushie here...
In fact, you were perfect! So perfect you have not one, but `two` bonus scenes!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, you were perfect! So perfect you have not one, but [b]two[/b] bonus scenes!

nodes.text: Later that night...
Officer Monte and Hawk Gunner sit face-to-face in the security office.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The two young Clydes I found wandering in the forest tell me you were their skiing instructor...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And that you fled at the first sniff of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk doesn't run at the sight of danger. The Hawk's middle name `is` Danger.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Hawk doesn't run at the sight of danger. The Hawk's middle name [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] Danger.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! I've heard that one before. Let me see that license of yours...
Stoically, Hawk Gunner slides his driver's license over.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're not lying! You're real name is Hawk Danger-Adventure-Flee Gunner!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk doesn't know why no one believes him.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, no matter what your middle name really is...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: ...You did flee the scene. Which makes you guilty!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk didn't do anything illegal.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No, but as the official in charge of running this ski lodge, you shirked your duties as ski instructor by running away from your students.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And if there's one thing Officer Monte hates, it's people that shirk their duties by running away...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Gulp!
And for the second bonus scene...
Just in case you were wondering what kind of 'mysterious author' would finance an entire school ski trip...
The night before...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Andy? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? Me? I'm, uh, just trying to get into my room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wouldn't a key help?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're right, Howard. I should go find one. Thanks for the help.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem.
Andy watches Howard go the other way down the hallway.
Cautiously, Andy steps in front of the door again, opens it, and goes inside.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Found your key?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Aaah! Lucretia!

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: You know you're getting soft in your old age if I and that Howard boy can get the drop on you.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I wasn't expecting you to be here before me.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: I got lucky. You'd think being CEO of the most profitable company on the West Coast would let me make my own schedule, so we wouldn't have to sneak around after work hours.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, well. I made it.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And as for Howard, he doesn't suspect a thing. None of the students really know what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: You know, I thought it was weird when you said you were staying in this exact lodge the exact same weekend Prince Automotives was holding their annual executive conference.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Isn't that lucky?

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Isn't this ski lodge a bit expensive for a public school?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Not if you win the money by becoming a profitable local author who sponsors school ski trips to the Sierras.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: A local author named `Daniell Y. Cannon` perhaps?
nodes.text_bbcode: A local author named [color=#3b78e2][i]Daniell Y. Cannon[/i][/color] perhaps?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: So I have a thing for anagrams.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Andy, did you write a book and plan this trip just so you could see me?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Maybe I just thought a school-wide ski trip to the mountains was an educational experience for today's urban youth.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Or maybe I wanted to see you.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Thank you.
And that's your perfect ending!
See you next time on Surviving High school!
